title: Weighted exponential mean inequality
statement:
Let $I$ be a finite set with weights $w_i\ge0$ and $\sum_{i\in I}w_i>0$. For any $d:I\to\mathbb R$ and any $\rho>0$,
\[
\left(\sum_{i\in I}w_i\right)\rho^{\left(\sum_{i\in I}w_i d_i\right)/(\sum_{i\in I}w_i)}\le\sum_{i\in I}w_i\rho^{d_i}.
\]
replaced: Let $I$ be a finite set with nonnegative weights $w_i$ with $\sum_iw_i>0$, let $d_i\in\mathbb R$, and let $\rho>0$. Then $(\sum_iw_i)\rho^{(\sum_iw_id_i)/(\sum_iw_i)}\le\sum_iw_i\rho^{d_i}$.
